Definition: Jether, the name of five or six Israelites and of one Midianite
BiblicalUsage: Jether = "abundance"; 1) father-in-law of Moses; 2) oldest son of Gideon; 3) father of Jephunneh and the chief of a line of warriors of the line of Asher; 4) father of Amasa, the commander of Absalom's army; 5) son of Jada, a descendant of Hezron, of the tribe of Judah; 6) a son of Ezra, a Judaite
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
